label: THE STRUCTURED / ENGLISH SHOULDER
description: The English suit is the most structured of all suits, featuring large padding and significant canvasing, it is also interlined with horsetail and reinforced with chest felt and tapes.  The shoulder line is extended and roped (save for a few exceptions such as Anderson & Sheppard) creating an almost martial appearance. Regular
